ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the diameter $AB=20$ of the semicircle $O$, and the chord $AC=12$. The chord $AD$ bisects $\angle BAC$. What is the length of $AD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect BD, BC, OD, intersecting BC at point F,\\
$\because$ AB is the diameter,\\
$\therefore \angle ACB = \angle ADB = 90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore BC = \sqrt{AB^2 - AC^2} = \sqrt{20^2 - 12^2} = 16$,\\
$\because$ AD bisects $\angle BAC$,\\
$\therefore \angle CAD = \angle DAB$,\\
$\therefore \overset{\frown}{CD} = \overset{\frown}{BD}$,\\
$\therefore$ OD$\perp$CB,\\
$\therefore$ BF = $\frac{1}{2}BC = 8$, $\angle BFO = 90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore OF = \sqrt{OB^2 - BF^2} = \sqrt{10^2 - 8^2} = 6$,\\
$\therefore DF = OD - OF = 10 - 6 = 4$,\\
In the right $\triangle DFB$,\\
$BD = \sqrt{DF^2 + BF^2} = \sqrt{4^2 + 8^2} = 4\sqrt{5}$,\\
In the right $\triangle ABD$,\\
$AD = \sqrt{AB^2 - BD^2} = \sqrt{20^2 - (4\sqrt{5})^2} = \boxed{8\sqrt{5}}$.

method.method_draft: Use the internal angle-bisector theorem plus intersecting chords. From the image, note that C and D lie on the same semicircle with diameter AB, and that the ray AD crosses the interior of triangle ABC before reaching D on the arc. Let E be the intersection of AD with BC. From the text, AB=20, AC=12, and AD is the bisector of angle BAC. Because AB is a diameter and C lies on the arc, triangle ABC is right at C, so BC=16. By the angle-bisector theorem in triangle ABC, BE:CE=AB:AC=20:12=5:3, so BE=10 and CE=6. The angle-bisector length formula gives AE^2=AB*AC-BE*CE, equivalently AE=sqrt(12*20*(1-16^2/(20+12)^2))=6sqrt(5). Since chords AD and BC intersect at E inside the circle, EA*ED=EB*EC=60, so ED=60/(6sqrt(5))=2sqrt(5). Therefore AD=AE+ED=8sqrt(5).
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个以 AB 为直径的上半圆，O 在 AB 上且为圆心。A 是左端点，B 是右端点。C 和 D 都在同一个半圆弧上，C 在左上方，D 在右上方。图中画出了弦 AC 和弦 AD，且 AD 从 A 出发位于 AB 与 AC 之间，并延长到半圆弧上的 D；若连接 BC，则射线 AD 会先在三角形 ABC 内部与 BC 相交后到达 D。

推理：设 E 为 AD 与 BC 的交点。因为 AB 是半圆的直径，且 C 在圆上，所以 ∠ACB = 90°。已知 AB = 20，AC = 12，因此 BC = sqrt(20^2 - 12^2) = sqrt(400 - 144) = 16。

AD 平分 ∠BAC，所以在三角形 ABC 中，E 是角平分线与 BC 的交点。由角平分线定理，BE:CE = AB:AC = 20:12 = 5:3。又 BC = 16，所以 BE = 10，CE = 6。

角平分线长度公式给出 AE^2 = AB·AC - BE·CE = 20·12 - 10·6 = 240 - 60 = 180，因此 AE = 6sqrt(5)。

因为 AD 和 BC 是圆内相交弦，交于 E，所以 EA·ED = EB·EC = 10·6 = 60。于是 ED = 60 / (6sqrt(5)) = 2sqrt(5)。

因此 AD = AE + ED = 6sqrt(5) + 2sqrt(5) = 8sqrt(5)。

AD 平分 ∠BAC，所以在三角形 ABC 中，E 是角平分线与 BC 的交点。由角平分线定理，BE:CE = AB:AC = 20:12 = 5:3。又 BC = 16，所以 BE = 10，CE = 6。

角平分线长度公式给出 AE^2 = AB·AC - BE·CE = 20·12 - 10·6 = 240 - 60 = 180，因此 AE = 6sqrt(5)。

因为 AD 和 BC 是圆内相交弦，交于 E，所以 EA·ED = EB·EC = 10·6 = 60。于是 ED = 60 / (6sqrt(5)) = 2sqrt(5)。

因此 AD = AE + ED = 6sqrt(5) + 2sqrt(5) = 8sqrt(5)。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, the diameter $AB=20$ of the semicircle $O$, and the chord $AC=12$. The chord $AD$ bisects $\angle BAC$. What is the length of $AD$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect BD, BC, OD, intersecting BC at point F,\\
$\because$ AB is the diameter,\\
$\therefore \angle ACB = \angle ADB = 90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore BC = \sqrt{AB^2 - AC^2} = \sqrt{20^2 - 12^2} = 16$,\\
$\because$ AD bisects $\angle BAC$,\\
$\therefore \angle CAD = \angle DAB$,\\
$\therefore \overset{\frown}{CD} = \overset{\frown}{BD}$,\\
$\therefore$ OD$\perp$CB,\\
$\therefore$ BF = $\frac{1}{2}BC = 8$, $\angle BFO = 90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore OF = \sqrt{OB^2 - BF^2} = \sqrt{10^2 - 8^2} = 6$,\\
$\therefore DF = OD - OF = 10 - 6 = 4$,\\
In the right $\triangle DFB$,\\
$BD = \sqrt{DF^2 + BF^2} = \sqrt{4^2 + 8^2} = 4\sqrt{5}$,\\
In the right $\triangle ABD$,\\
$AD = \sqrt{AB^2 - BD^2} = \sqrt{20^2 - (4\sqrt{5})^2} = \boxed{8\sqrt{5}}$
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, AB can be seen as a horizontal line segment, A is at the left end, B is at the right end, and O is marked near the midpoint of AB; above is a semicircular arc with AB as the diameter. C and D are both on the upper semicircular arc, and the chord AC from A to C and the chord AD from A to D are drawn. The problem statement gives AB=20, AC=12, and AD bisects ∠BAC. Reasoning: Because AB is the diameter of the semicircle and C is on the semicircle, by Thales' theorem, ∠ACB=90°; D is also on the semicircle, so ∠ADB=90°. In the right triangle ABC, AB is the hypotenuse, AC=12, AB=20, therefore cos∠BAC=AC/AB=12/20=3/5. Also because AD bisects ∠BAC, ∠DAB=(1/2)∠BAC. In the right triangle ABD, AB is the hypotenuse, and AD is the adjacent side of ∠DAB, therefore AD=AB·cos∠DAB. Using the half-angle formula: cos(∠BAC/2)=sqrt((1+cos∠BAC)/2)=sqrt((1+3/5)/2)=sqrt(4/5)=2/sqrt(5). So AD=20·2/sqrt(5)=40/sqrt(5)=8sqrt(5).
